definitions.explanation: A catastrophic earthquake and the devastation it causes. Used above all in the names of Japan's worst earthquakes.

examples.japanese: {大震災|だいしんさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{大震災|だいしんさい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Ten years have passed since that great earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧{大震災|だいしんさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧9⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧1{日|ついたち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧」になっている。
examples.english: September 1, the day of the Great Kanto Earthquake, is now Disaster Prevention Day.

notes:
{大|だい} (great) + ⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧ (earthquake disaster). ⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧ names the disaster and its damage; ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧ names the earthquake itself.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧{大震災|だいしんさい}: the Great Kanto Earthquake (1923)
- {阪神|はんしん}・{淡路|あわじ}{大震災|だいしんさい}: the Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake (1995)
- {東日本|ひがしにほん}{大震災|だいしんさい}: the Great East Japan Earthquake (2011)
